events.summary:
FFWEPZ

The National Weather Service in El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa has extended
the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northwestern Dona Ana County in south central New Mexico...

* Until 615 PM MDT.

* At 512 PM MDT, video from storm chasers still showed arroyos along
highway 185 were dangerously inundated, although water appears to
have crested. It will take some time for water to recede.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Public reported.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Peaceful Valley and Rinconcito.

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
The areas affected include...
Straits of Florida from Halfmoon Shoal to 20 nm west of Dry Tortugas
out 60 nm...
Straits of Florida from west end of Seven Mile Bridge to south of
Halfmoon Shoal 20 to 60 nm out...

At 709 PM EDT, National Weather Service meteorologists detected a
large cluster of strong thunderstorms, capable of producing wind
gusts near 30 knots. These thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 35 nm south of Tortugas Ecological Reserve South to
46 nm south of Twenty-Eight Foot Shoal Light, moving northeast at 10
knots.

Strong thunderstorms will remain over mainly open waters.

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northwestern Mohave County in northwestern Arizona...

heavy rain across the warned area. Between 0.5 and 1 inch of rain

events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Central Logan County in southeastern North Dakota...

* WHEN...Until 715 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 559 PM CDT, heavy rain due to thunderstorms had ended in the
advisory area. However another round of thunderstorms is possible
tonight. Minor flooding is likely ongoing in the advisory area.
If thunderstorms develop again, the Advisory may need to be
extended.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Beaver Lake State Park and Burnstad.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.summary:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Western Kane County in southern Utah...
East Central Washington County in southwestern Utah...

* Until 900 PM MDT.

* At 457 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across portions of Zion National Park, and additional
heavier rain is anticipated to move into the area over the next
hour. Up to 0.25 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall
amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are possible in the warned area. Flash
flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of slot canyons, normally
dry washes, creeks and streams.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Zion National Park and Springdale.
